## TL;DR

Review round 1 found that my first CSS fix was too narrow in two places, and that it left a 1000px case unsolved. I fixed all three and the two smaller items. The Work dock now lifts above the integration pill from 761px to 1100px, and it stays out of the fixed flow below 761px, which preserves phone-reflow Work. The Settings tab strip now scrolls up to 960px. The regression file covers twelve WebKit cases, and four of them fail on the original CSS. The QA measurement script is committed under `docs/qa/` so the record reproduces without an ignored file.

## Work and rationale

Round 1 raised three issues. The dock breakpoint had moved to 720px, so phone-reflow Work at 720–760px received a fixed toggle row and a fixed fade that covered cards mid-scroll. I restored the 761px base. The Settings scroller ended at 900px, but at 901px the 210px sidebar leaves the strip about 639px against roughly 695px of tabs, so it clipped again from 901 to 957px. Its breakpoint is now 960px. The third issue was the dock at 901–1090px, where the 520px pill reservation left the toggles too little width. The stacked layout now covers 761–1100px. The row's left edge stays at the sidebar, or at the 60px rail up to 900px, and its right edge sits 16px from the gutter.

The reviewer also noted that the test fixture only rendered the idle pill and did not exercise the 740px phone band. I added a 740px case that checks the dock stays out of the fixed flow, and I added 1000px to the dock cases. The reproduce command for the QA record now points at `docs/qa/measure-mobile-widths.mjs`, and I removed the import that pointed at this machine's worktree path.

## Approaches tried

For the 740px case I first wrote a geometry assertion, but the phone-reflow board pins its height inline, so the fixture could not show the reflow. I switched to asserting the computed position is not `fixed`, which is the rule the fix depends on.

I checked the new tests the same way as before: once against the fixed CSS, and once against HEAD's CSS, which I swapped in and then restored. Twelve pass on the fix and four fail on HEAD.

## Challenges and blockers

The expanded integration pill is still not covered. The dock sits 66px above the bottom edge, which assumes the pill is no taller than about 52px. An expanded pill grows upward and could reach the toggles. The test renders only the idle pill. I recorded this as an open risk in the QA record rather than guessing a height.

The Settings and Releases panels remain unverified in the auth-less session, because their API calls return 401s. The floating avatars covering the Settings theme stars at 768px is still a product decision. It is recorded in the QA record and I did not change it.

## Key learnings

A breakpoint that is right for one layout can clip in the next one. When I moved the dock to 720px to fix a band, I created a new break at 720–760px. The check that caught it was a list of the neighbouring widths on either side of each change, not just the width I was fixing. The same goes for the Settings scroller: the fix at 900px was only correct if the sidebar width at 901px also left enough room, and I had not measured that.
